quest.title: We'll Dance Together Again!
quest.description: The dance exchange has been incredibly fruitful for both the Natlan and Sumeru dancers...

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: Well done, everyone! I must say, this exchange has been absolute perfection so far!

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: Quite a few of our friends from Sumeru have learned our styles of dance... I can already see our dances spreading across Teyvat!

dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: I hope we can take turns to visit each other and make this dance exchange a regular tradition in the future!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, will the saurians of Natlan be able to do blade-dances like The Eremites do?

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: Huh? Are you talking about the intimidating actions that Uncle Scimitar and the others used to scare off the Consecrated Red Vultures the first time Nusta met him?

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: Did he not tell you where those movements are from?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Yeah, he did. What did he call that dance...? "The Duet of Flame-Mane and Heron's Guard"? I like that name — conveys both grace and power!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, those two names sounds familiar!

choices.text: Reminds me of two of my friends...

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon — yes, I suppose this won't come as a complete surprise to you.

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: The place where you encountered the Consecrated Red Vultures is close to a road frequented by the Blazing Beasts' sumpter beast caravan.

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: Some time ago, a caravan that was carrying Dehya and Candace back to Aaru Village encountered that very same flock of red vultures.

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: The two of them, feeling like they hadn't quite gotten their fill of exercise on that outing, decided to go all out on those vultures.

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: Since then, whenever a member of the Blazing Beasts mimics their actions, those vultures simply take off.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah. It's just as Paimon thought...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess the vultures were just unlucky that day, huh? To have run into *both* Dehya and Candace...?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I'll say! Gah, can't believe I missed the chance to learn from these two aces...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: You must introduce me to the two of them the next time we go to Sumeru!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I'd love to pick their brains on boxing techniques, especially how to catch the rhythm on those crazy fast, powerful punches that get their energy all the way from the feet, through the legs and torso, before exploding out of the arms and into the fist!

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: Ha! I'm sure that the lot of you will end up drinking the night away, too...

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: I'll have to prepare something to sober you all up.

choices.text: I think I can guess at what's going on...
The kind that can scare red vultures off...
